title: Natalie's New Year Celebration Ends with New Charges
description:
Sarasota police responded to a report of a scuffle at a Florida bar after the New Year rang in. Officers were met with a mouthy 20-year-old and her girlfriend, who begged police to let her go. Natalie Brown allegedly pushed her girlfriend after getting in an argument. Brown appeared to believe she did not commit a crime, while her partner insisted she didn't want to press charges. Find out what happened next on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
